item.title: Inside a Noodsteunpunt: Lessons from an Emergency Exercise in Alkmaar
item.description: A noodsteunpunt is a local emergency support point where residents can go for help during a large-scale crisis. When I read that the municipality of Alkmaar was running a full exercise at community centre Mare Nostrum, I reached out to ask if I could join.

item.title: Building Buurtbox v0.1 for the DACC Digitale Autonomie Unconference
item.description: As a part of the Buurtbox project, I have been researching existing projects that touch on resilience and autonomy. That is how I came across the Digital Autonomy Competence Center (DACC).

item.title: Pilot
item.description:
Buurtbox Pilot

Help us test resilient digital infrastructure in the neighbourhood

What happens when a neighbourhood loses internet and electricity during an emergency?

Buurtbox is an open-source, energy-efficient offline information station designed to keep essential digital information available when normal digital infrastructure is unavailable.

We are now looking for organisations and communities that want to help us test this concept in practice.

We are looking for pilot partners for the first Buurtbox prototype, planned for Q1 2027.
